parameters.label: Repetitions and hesitation
parameters.good: Completed wording remains readable while the speaker's meaning is retained.

parameters.label: False starts and self-corrections
parameters.good: The speaker's final intended phrasing is retained in its original order.

parameters.label: Unfamiliar terms
parameters.good: Unfamiliar terms remain uncertain when the transcript alone cannot establish the intended word.

parameters.label: Uncertainty
parameters.good: Ambiguous wording is preserved without an unsupported confident correction.

parameters.label: Meaningful short responses
parameters.good: Meaningful short answers, including yes and no, are retained.

parameters.label: Completed information
parameters.good: Substantive information remains in the speaker's original order.

parameters.label: Multiple speakers
parameters.good: Speech from different speakers is attributed only when the transcript provides evidence.
